name: Stream Graph
description: Series stacked about a central baseline so they flow as one river, with names set inside each layer where it is widest.

props.name: series
props.type: { name: string; data: number[]; color?: string }[]
props.description: One layer per entry, with a value per label. Colours follow the chart palette unless given. Layers are ordered so the ones that peak early sit in the middle.

props.name: labels
props.description: One label per point along the bottom. Crowded labels thin out.

props.name: titles
props.description: Longer names for the tooltip and table, one per label, e.g. "Week of 5 January".

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels. The width follows the card.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes values in the tooltip, legend and scale key. Defaults to grouped whole numbers.

props.name: totalName
props.description: Name of the total row in the tooltip and table, e.g. "All resorts".

props.name: unitName
props.description: Words after the number in the scale key, e.g. "visitors a week".

props.name: legend
props.description: Show a legend with each layer's total and a key for the stream's thickness.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: A title under the horizontal axis. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated from the data when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change as a signed fraction, shown as a chip beside the value.

props.name: footer
props.description: Replaces the legend under the plot.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card, e.g. a width. Also accepts note, action, invertDelta and every other prop of a div.
